name: filetree-local
description: IDE-style file tree pane for Claude Code, local build

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the pane opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /filetree.

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity glows in the tree: files read with Read, Grep or Glob in purple; files written with Edit, Write, NotebookEdit or a shell command in orange; files Claude committed or staged in green.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads or writes and stays there. off: the view stays where you put it; highlights still show.

refresh.title: Auto refresh
refresh.description: How often the tree and git status are read again while the pane shows, so changes made outside this session appear (another session, an editor, a terminal). off: only on focus, ↻ and Claude's own work. Commits and staging in the session's repository show within a second either way.

hints.title: Hints
hints.description: on: outside a git repo, a line under the header says git status starts after git init. off: the line is hidden and the tree gets the row.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last modified), age (time since last modified: now, 12m, 3h, 5d, then Oct 9, then the year) or size (files in bytes, folders as the total under them, measured in the background). The Σ button switches between size and the date or age.

glyphs.title: Icons
glyphs.description: auto: Nerd Font icons in the terminal when a Nerd Font is installed on this machine; plain everywhere else. nerd: always Nerd Font icons. plain: Unicode only.

open.title: Open with
open.description: What a double-click or Enter does with a file. app: the default Windows app (programs and scripts are never run). preview: show it in the pane (← goes back; ↗ opens the default app). select: only select it.

edit.title: Edit with
edit.description: What e does in the preview: open the file in this editor at the top line shown, through its vscode://-style link. off: the edit button is hidden.

selection.title: Selection in prompt
selection.description: How Claude learns what you picked in the tree, always in plain sight. mention: a puts @path of the row under the cursor in the prompt box, and @ in the footer does it for the selected file. append: also adds a line (selected in the file tree: path) to the end of each prompt you type while a file is selected. off: neither. @mentions you type reveal the file in the tree either way.
